brandGuardrails.brandVariantPolicy: 品牌名必须逐字等于‘铁毅祥河洛面’，不接受任何替代写法。

description.en: Evidence-based hiring posters for Chinese restaurant storefronts, A-frames and social media.
description.zh: 基于国内餐饮实战案例的门店水牌、A4 招聘海报和社媒招聘视觉。

description.en: Twenty user-supplied screenshots analyzed for transferable layout systems, with unverified official status and explicit trademark boundaries.
description.zh: 20 张用户提供的品牌招聘截图，提炼可迁移版式系统，并明确官方状态未核验与商标禁用边界。

description.en: Twenty user-supplied references for hero-support layouts, dish matrices, price menus, storefront lightboxes and regional food collages.
description.zh: 20 张用户提供案例，覆盖主菜＋辅菜、菜品矩阵、价格菜单、实体灯箱与地域美食拼贴。

description.en: Routes a real hiring brief to one proven Chinese restaurant-poster structure.
description.zh: 把真实招聘需求路由到一种经过案例验证的中国餐饮招聘结构。

useWhen.en: Use for restaurant hiring posters where positions, pay and contact details must be understood immediately.
useWhen.zh: 用于岗位、待遇和联系方式必须一眼看懂的餐饮招聘海报。

en: Select exactly one primary case family before prompting.
Keep positions and contact information above decorative storytelling.
Use exact approved copy and verify every Chinese character.
zh: 生成前只选择一个主案例结构。
岗位和联系方式的优先级高于装饰叙事。
硬编码批准文案并逐字校验中文。

en: Do not invent salaries, benefits, addresses or QR codes.
Do not mix every reference into one poster.
The brand name must match the approved canonical name character for character.
zh: 不要虚构工资、福利、地址或二维码。
不要把所有参考风格堆进一张海报。
不要用相似面食品类词替换品牌标准名。

description.en: Transfers information hierarchy and campaign logic from one benchmark while replacing every identity asset.
description.zh: 从单一品牌案例迁移信息层级与 Campaign 逻辑，同时替换全部身份资产。

useWhen.en: Use when a mature chain-brand reference is needed for hierarchy, modularity or campaign consistency.
useWhen.zh: 用于需要成熟连锁品牌的信息层级、模块化或系列一致性时。

en: Select exactly one benchmark case and one transferable mechanism.
Replace every logo, mascot, product, illustration and slogan with authorized brand-owned material.
zh: 只选择一个品牌基准案例和一个可迁移机制。
所有 Logo、吉祥物、产品、插画和口号必须替换为自有或获授权资产。

en: Do not treat visible brand marks as proof of official publication.
Do not clone a benchmark composition pixel for pixel.
Do not mix identity systems from multiple brands.
zh: 画面出现商标不等于已证明由官方发布。
不要像素级复刻单一案例。
不要混用多个品牌的身份系统。

title.zh: 多菜品与招牌菜海报路由器

description.en: Chooses one evidence-backed food hierarchy before arranging dish images, names, prices and campaign copy.
description.zh: 先选择一种经过案例验证的菜品层级，再编排菜图、菜名、价格与推广文案。

useWhen.en: Use when one poster must promote two or more dishes, a set meal, a seasonal collection or a storefront menu lightbox.
useWhen.zh: 用于一张海报需要推广两款以上菜品、套餐、季节合集或门店菜单灯箱时。

en: Choose exactly one case and one dish hierarchy.
Bind every dish name and price to its corresponding image.
Normalize light direction, perspective, plate scale and contact shadows before styling.
zh: 只选择一个案例和一种菜品层级。
每个菜名与价格必须绑定对应菜图。
设计装饰前先统一光向、透视、盘径比例与接触阴影。

en: Do not treat screenshot bars, UI, watermarks or portfolio marks as design elements.
Do not invent ingredients, origin, health claims, prices or set-meal quantities.
Do not mix multiple reference systems into one poster.
zh: 不要把截图黑边、平台 UI、水印或作品集标识当作设计元素。
不要虚构原料、产地、健康主张、价格或套餐数量。
不要把多个参考系统混进一张海报。
